title: Query API (features/query)
description: The public query API: botspy.sessions(source=None), iterating sessions then messages then parts, with filters by kind, time, and project. Lazy and streaming; read-only. Specs first: features/query/*.feature is the source of truth; implementation is generated from the specs.
right_now_summary: The query API specs need writing and review, while the sessions API has no recent work reported.
